title: Zarch (1987) Gameplay for BBC Acorn Archimedes High Quality
summary: Gameplay footage of Zarch, the 1987 3D Defender-like game by David Braben for the Acorn Archimedes. It shows the 256-colour 3D landscape where you stop landers spreading a virus.
why: HN commenters recall it as a mind-blowing early 3D game that showed what the Archimedes hardware could do.

quote.text: It's an awesome 3D game from 1987 (with truly awful sound).
